notes: Home connectivity fix — root cause: with no gateway configured (honest offline-first), the REST layer still fired requests and Ktor's URLBuilder resolved the relative path against its implicit http://localhost default, so Android's network security policy (correctly) blocked the cleartext call — Home showed 'Could not reach gateway — CLEARTEXT communication to localhost not permitted'. Fix: a gateway guard at every REST entry (zero requests fire while unconfigured, honest actionable copy instead) + the deployment manifest is now bootstrapped from the HTTPS repo CDN when offline, so a gateway published into update-manifest.json is adopted with zero rebuild. No network-security weakening (cleartext stays blocked). Tests: data-module JVM 7/7 (MockEngine + real OkHttp engine against a loopback origin). Also ships the Wave 3-HW TURN ICE plumbing. APK versionCode 15.
